artworks.title: Masque
artworks.medium: etching in red on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows the head of a person with exaggerated facial features on a beige background. The person has furrowed brows, a broad nose, a downturned mouth, and sparse reddish-brown hair with more volume on the sides. The facial expression is intense and fierce, highlighted by sharp lines and shading. The surroundings consist only of the plain beige background, emphasizing the striking features of the face without any additional context or objects. No jewelry or accessories are present, keeping the focus solely on the distinct facial expression.

artworks.title: Masque
artworks.medium: etching in green on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized face of a person with exaggerated facial features typical of traditional Japanese art. The face includes prominently arched eyebrows, wide eyes, a wrinkled forehead, and a downturned mouth. The hair is dark and receding, extending along both sides of the head with most of the top bald. The expression is intense and fierce. The face is depicted in monochrome with varying shades. There are no other elements in the image, and the background is plain beige.

artworks.title: Quelques croquis
artworks.medium: softground etching and drypoint in black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows an etching on a large piece of paper with multiple partial facial profiles and headshots. Several faces are drawn in different angles and positions, highlighting noses, eyes, mouths, and hair. The focus is primarily on the faces and heads, with minimal clothing detail. The central face appears to be wearing a hat, and other faces also display headgear or embellishments. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface that blends into the larger blank area surrounding it on the paper.

artworks.title: Quelques croquis
artworks.medium: softground etching and drypoint in red-brown on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of various facial features on a piece of beige paper in the center of a larger blank space. The sketches include eyes, noses, mouths, facial hair, and headwear. The style is rough and loose, with different expressions and profiles depicted.

artworks.title: Etude (Le rameur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a torso view of a person seated in a boat, who appears to be rowing. The person is facing forward, with arms extended as they grip the oars. Their facial features are depicted with soft shading, showing a concentrated expression. Their hair is short and dark. The person's upper body is unclothed, revealing a muscular build. They are rowing, emphasizing the movement of their arms and upper body. The background is a rough rendering of a body of water and the sky, indicated by horizontal strokes and varying shades. The image is in grayscale.

artworks.title: Etude (Le rameur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a seated position within a small boat. He is seen slightly leaning forward and holding onto oars. He appears focused with short dark hair, shirtless, and wearing loosely fitted pants. The surroundings include elements of a simple boat structure. The background illustrates a simple, painterly depiction of water and indistinct land or other environmental elements in a monochromatic color scheme.

artworks.title: Etude de femme
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and part of the upper torso. The person is depicted in a slightly angled position, looking upward and to the left. The facial features are expressive, with a hint of a smile, prominent cheekbones, and softly arched eyebrows. The person has voluminous, dark, wavy hair that frames their face and falls around the shoulders. There is no visible clothing or accessories. The sketch is rendered in a style that blends the figure into the neutral-toned background, giving the appearance that the person is emerging from the surrounding texture. The surrounding area is filled with sketch-like strokes that add depth to the image. The artwork is signed near the top left with a small, detailed monogram.

artworks.title: Etude de femme (Study of a Woman)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This image is a detailed sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The person is seen sideways, with their head tilted slightly upwards to the right. They have a youthful face with prominent cheekbones, a softly rounded nose, and full lips. The individual has long, dark hair styled in waves around their face. The clothing is minimal and draped loosely over the shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, but surrounded by dynamic lines and shading to highlight the subject's profile. There is a signature or inscription in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Petite fille
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson

artworks.title: Petite fille (Young Girl)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a young child from the chest up. The child is turned slightly to their left, showing their face in partial profile. They have wide eyes and plump cheeks, with long hair past their shoulders. The child is wearing a high-collared garment, likely a dress, and a headband. The background is minimally detailed, creating a simple and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: untitled (Woman descending onto a street of umbrellas)
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The full-body sketch depicts a person standing on a paved walkway. The person is leaning slightly back and has short hair. They wear a loose garment resembling a dress and stand in a casual pose. The person's facial features are outlined with a lively expression, and they seem to be holding an umbrella or a walking stick. Large umbrella-like shapes are around them, potentially representing open umbrellas on the ground. In the background, a wall or building can be seen, along with a sign reading "ODÉON". The image is drawn in a loose, gestural style with minimalistic line work on a plain background.

artworks.title: untitled (Woman descending onto a street of umbrellas)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person in a three-quarter view. The person is leaning to the side, holding onto a railing or a bar. Their face is turned downward, with lightly sketched facial features. The hair is styled upwards, possibly in a loose updo with visible strands. They wear a flowing dress with billowing sleeves and stand with their feet on a surface resembling the edge of a stage or platform. Surrounding the person are loosely sketched objects, including a table with a cloth, an umbrella, and a backdrop suggesting a stage or indoor environment. A sign with the word "ODEON" is visible on the left side. The sketch is on a plain, light-colored background.

artworks.title: L'intruse
artworks.medium: etching in green on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in a poised manner. The person is facing to the side, with their left hand resting on the doorknob of an open door. The person has minimalist facial features and long hair blending into their attire. They are dressed in a long, flowing garment with a contrasting dark outer layer. The person is holding a spherical object in their right arm. In the background, there is a faint outline of a leafy pattern, hinting at an exterior setting beyond the door. The surrounding area appears plain, drawing focus to the central figure and the doorframe.

artworks.title: Étude
artworks.medium: report (?) lithograph in brown on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two human figures from full-body perspectives. One figure is standing with its back facing the viewer, leaning slightly with arms wrapped around the head of the other figure. The other figure is crouched and partially obscured, with one knee on the ground and an arm reaching up towards the standing figure's shoulder. The sketch portrays simplified human forms without detailed facial features or hair, emphasizing the outline and pose of the bodies. The figures are nude, depicted with rough lines and a textured appearance. The background is plain and composed of the same beige color as the paper with no additional details.

artworks.title: Etude
artworks.medium: report (?) lithograph [photolithograph?] in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two nude figures standing closely together. The image depicts both figures rendered in a sketch-like manner with visible grid lines around them. The figures are outlined in soft pencil or charcoal, with some shading to indicate muscle tone and form. One figure stands slightly bent, leaning against the other, whose posture is more upright. The drawing focuses on form and body dynamics, emphasizing the tension and interaction between the two forms. The background is left blank.

artworks.title: La bailli
artworks.medium: softground etching in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image contains a small, square etching at the center bottom of a large blank paper. The etching depicts an upper-body view of a person in profile, facing right. The individual has distinct facial features with prominent lips and a nose, and long hair. The person is wearing a dark coat with a high collar and appears to be in a thoughtful posture. The background of the etching has dark and light tones, and the surrounding area outside the etching is plain.

artworks.title: La bailli
artworks.medium: softground etching in red-brown on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a small sepia-toned illustration in the center of a large, pale beige sheet. The illustration depicts a person's upper body in a seated position, viewed at an angle. The person appears to be wearing a fur-collared garment and a broad-brimmed hat that casts a shadow over their face, making specific facial features difficult to discern. The person's hair, if visible, is obscured by the hat. The attire seems to be thick, indicating warmth and protection from the cold. No jewelry or objects are apparent due to the scale and dark contrast of the illustration. The sheet surrounding the illustration is plain and unadorned, offering a neutral backdrop that draws attention to the central image.

artworks.title: Deux croquis
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image contains two illustrations on a beige background. The top right illustration depicts a head with defined facial features, short curly hair, a serious expression, and a dark garment or collar around the neck. The bottom left illustration shows half of a person's upper body with a contemplative expression, high cheekbones, arched eyebrows, a top hat, curly hair, and a dark coat. There are no other objects or jewelry in the image, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Deux croquis
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: There are two face illustrations on a plain background. One face is in the top right, featuring rugged lines and spikey hair. The other face is in the lower left, showing a person in a contemplative pose with a hat, glasses, a nose, and a mustache. Both drawings are in a monochrome greenish tone.

artworks.title: Souvenir de Bretagne
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's body, from the top of the head to mid-thigh, in profile facing slightly downward. The individual appears to be standing, with their head bent forward and arms tucked in front. The person's facial features are minimally outlined, while their hair is pulled back into a low bun secured with a dark hairband or headscarf. They are wearing a loosely draped garment that falls to their knees. The background is plain and light-hued, with no visible accessories or objects.

artworks.title: Souvenir de Bretagne
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of a young girl from the waist up, slightly turned to the side with her head bowed and looking downward. The girl's facial features are depicted with minimal detail, and her long hair is tied back with a dark band. She is dressed in a long-sleeved garment with a textured pattern, and the background is a blank, light brown surface. No objects or jewelry are visible in the drawing.

artworks.title: Lutteurs
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: In the image, a group of people is depicted in an outdoor setting. A woman's upper body and back are shown on the left side. She has dark hair styled up and wears a long, patterned dress with long sleeves. To her side is another woman with curly hair. In the middle ground to the right, a man is shown from the knees up. He is standing shirtless, wearing only shorts and fur-like adornments around his ankles, holding a stick. Behind him, several men are standing in a shaded area dressed in coats and hats. The background features a tent or shelter made of fabric and wooden poles, with a wooden object on the ground.

artworks.title: Lutteurs
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows several figures. The central figure is a muscular man standing and adjusting something in his hands. He is wearing dark shorts, with bands around his wrists and ankles. He has short hair and a concentrated expression on his face. In the foreground, a woman is seen from the back, wearing a full-length dress with a patterned, long-sleeved top. Her hair is styled up. In the background, there are two men partially obscured in shadow, both dressed in jackets and trousers, observing the scene. Wooden platforms and structures are visible, and the setting appears to be indoors or covered.

artworks.title: Sainte Agnès
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a figure sitting on a rock. Nearby, a young woman is posed gracefully with her hands clasped near her chest, looking out into the landscape. She is wearing a flowing dress and sitting on rocky terrain that leads to a path towards a collection of trees. In the background, there are hills or clouds in the distance. On the left are slender trees. The drawing features a mix of soft lines and dark shading, with a monochromatic color palette of black and gray.
